name: Hotel Greil
beschreibung: The Hotel Greil is located in the town centre of Söll in the Wilder Kaiser holiday region. The surrounding area offers access to the Skiwelt Wilder Kaiser – Brixental and to a dense network of hiking trails in the Kitzbüheler Alpen. The atmosphere of the house is characterised by traditional Tiroler style and family-run management. The amenities include, among other things, a wellness area with sauna and steam bath, as well as rooms in an Alpine country-house style. The hotel's own restaurant serves regional Tiroler cuisine. Guests use the hotel as a starting point for skiing, hiking or cycling in the surrounding area. It offers a quiet yet central location as a base for active holidaymakers and those seeking relaxation.
